programs.name: B.Tech
programs.eligibility: 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics and minimum 50% aggregate marks; JEE Main / state entrance score or the university's own entrance evaluation considered.
programs.overview: A full-time, campus-based engineering program offered with specializations including Computer Science Engineering, Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning, Data Science & AI Engineering, Electronics & Communication Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, Civil Engineering and Mechanical Engineering.
programs.admission_process: Merit-based on Class XII marks and JEE Main/state entrance score or the university's own entrance evaluation, followed by Personal Interview.

programs.name: B.Tech (Lateral Entry)
programs.duration: 3.5 Years (entry into 3rd semester of the 4-year program)
programs.eligibility: 3-year Diploma in Engineering from a recognized institution.
programs.overview: A lateral-entry pathway into the B.Tech program for diploma holders, joining directly at the third semester.
programs.admission_process: Merit-based on Diploma marks, followed by counselling/interview as applicable.

programs.name: BBA
programs.eligibility: 10+2 in any stream with minimum 50% aggregate marks.
programs.overview: An undergraduate management program covering business fundamentals, communication, analytics and specialization electives.
programs.admission_process: Merit-based on Class XII marks, followed by counselling/interview as applicable.

programs.name: BBA (Financial Investment Analysis)
programs.eligibility: 10+2 in any stream with minimum 50% aggregate marks.
programs.overview: A specialized business administration program focused on financial markets, investment analysis and portfolio management alongside core management education.
programs.admission_process: Merit-based on Class XII marks, followed by counselling/interview as applicable.

programs.name: BCA
programs.eligibility: 10+2 with Mathematics as a mandatory subject and minimum 50% aggregate marks.
programs.overview: A computer applications program offered with specializations including Data Science & AI, Cyber Security, DevOps & Automation, Cloud Computing, and Mobile Application & Web Technology.
programs.admission_process: As per ICFAI Tech School undergraduate admissions process.

programs.name: B.Com (Hons.)
programs.eligibility: 10+2 in any stream with minimum 50% aggregate marks.
programs.overview: An undergraduate commerce program covering accounting, finance, taxation and business economics.
programs.admission_process: As per the university's undergraduate admissions process.

programs.name: B.Sc (Hons.) Mathematics
programs.eligibility: 10+2 with Mathematics and minimum 50% aggregate marks.
programs.overview: An undergraduate mathematics program emphasizing mathematical foundations, analytical reasoning and quantitative methods.
programs.admission_process: As per ICFAI Tech School undergraduate admissions process.

programs.name: B.Sc (Data Science)
programs.eligibility: 10+2 with Mathematics and minimum 50% aggregate marks.
programs.overview: An undergraduate program focused on statistics, programming, data analytics and visualization.
programs.admission_process: As per ICFAI Tech School undergraduate admissions process.

programs.name: BBA-LLB (Hons.)
programs.eligibility: 10+2 in any stream with minimum 45% aggregate marks; CLAT/ILSAT or equivalent law entrance considered.
programs.overview: An integrated law program combining management education with legal studies, BCI-approved, with moot courts and mandatory internships.
programs.admission_process: Based on CLAT/ILSAT or equivalent law entrance score and Class XII marks, followed by counselling.

programs.name: BA-LLB (Hons.)
programs.eligibility: 10+2 in any stream with minimum 45% aggregate marks; CLAT/ILSAT or equivalent law entrance considered.
programs.overview: An integrated law program combining arts subjects with core legal education, moot courts and mandatory internships.
programs.admission_process: Based on CLAT/ILSAT or equivalent law entrance score and Class XII marks, followed by counselling.

programs.name: LLB
programs.eligibility: Bachelor's degree in any discipline with minimum 45% aggregate marks.
programs.overview: A three-year professional law degree, BCI-approved, with moot courts, internships and practice-oriented training.
programs.admission_process: Merit-based on qualifying degree marks, followed by counselling/interview as applicable.

programs.name: B.Ed
programs.eligibility: Bachelor's/Master's degree with minimum 50% aggregate marks, as per NCTE norms.
programs.overview: An NCTE-approved teacher education program combining pedagogy coursework with school internships and hands-on teaching practice.
programs.admission_process: Merit-based on qualifying degree marks and/or state B.Ed entrance score, as per NCTE norms.
